main_text.p: אוגָרָא ׳ אוֹגֵר Ch. Vide in יגר.
לְיָגוֹא Syr. Ἀγρὸς, Ager. Plur. לְיָגוֹא Agri.
אגִירִים Ch. Ἀγρεῦ, Agrestis. Plur. סוּסְן אֲגִרִיסִין Equi agrestes, Jerem.5.8. Regia reddunt, Equi emissarii.
לְזֹבָא Syr. Merces, Stipendium, ad Rom.6.23. Negotiatio, Mercatura, Matt.22.5. Quæstus, 1. ad Tim.6.6.
אָדָם Adam, Homo. Vide & in דם.
אַדְמָתָא ׳ אַדְמָא Ch. Terra, proprie rubra.
אֻדְנָא ׳ אוּדְנָא ׳ אוֹדֶן Chal. לְאֻדְנָא Syr. Auris. Ex Hebræo אֹזֶן, mutato ז pro more in ר, unde & Græcum οὖς auris, & οὖτον auricula, derivatum. Plural. אוּדְנִין, לְאֻדְנֵי
אֲדִין Ch. Tunc: assumit ab initio בַּאדִין quod est pleonasticum.
אֲדַק Ch. Adhæsit, Cohæsit, Thren. 4.8. Ithpah. אִתְאֲדַק Idē, Job.41.8.14. & Deut.28.60. in Jon.
אֲדַר Chal. Adar, Nomen mensis duodecimi, qui Februario nostro respondet.
אֲדְרָא ׳ אֲדַר Ch. לְדָּן Syr. Area, Horreum. Plur. אֲדְרִין, אֲדְרָיָא.
אֲדְרָא Ch. Species arboris. Quidam Ficum: alii Salicem exponunt, Esth.7.10. in Targ.sec.
אֲדְרוֹן Cubiculum, Cöclave. Plur. אֲדְרוֹנִין, const. אֲדְרוֹנֵי Jobi 9.9. Videtur esse ex Hebr. חֶדֶר, ח cõmutato in א.

page.notes: Greek, Hebrew and Syriac words were reproduced from the scan as closely as possible; the Hebrew vowel points and several Syriac forms are partly illegible and may not be exact. Several Hebrew and Syriac lines are only approximated.
